### 8. Accept the design

Resolve interface confidence under [the technical-writing standards (source: guides/technical-writing-standards.md#label-interface-confidence-in-ai-written-specifications)], resolve every `[NEEDS YOUR CALL]` decision, and give every requirement an owner. Run [coherence review](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/document-review--when-coherence-review-runs.md) when the TDD is close to done and its readiness prerequisites hold. Coherence edits and documents changed by cascade, including parents, receive change checks and renewed gates; review affected downstream documents. Agents accept the TDD through [Approvals](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/product-documentation-process--approvals.md) after its review loop and required checks.
